assumptions: MCP clients tolerate z.union schemas in Zod for the decisions array — Claude Code and MCP SDK both accept discriminated unions at the tool-input layer.
Callers who send structured decision objects prefer exact round-trip over inference; they will provide their own domain / confidence when they care.
context: Fixed twining_record NL parser truncation + alternatives undercount; added structured decision schema variant and hardened decisions_created response. 19 new tests, 835 total passing (was 816).
rationale: Added a structured union variant to twining_record's decisions field: each item is either a string (NL path) or an object { summary, rationale?, alternatives?, assumptions?, constraints?, confidence?, context?, domain? }. When structured, the parser is bypassed entirely, guaranteeing exact round-trip. Alternative rejected: separate twining_record_structured tool (doubles the tool surface, splits documentation). Alternative rejected: always-parse NL (cannot handle long multi-paragraph rationales reliably).
